description.value: Riverside Motel is a roadside motel situated on the Crowsnest Highway (Highway 3) in the Grand Forks area of the Boundary region in British Columbia. It sits along a popular east-west cycling corridor connecting the Okanagan to the Kootenays. The 'gf' in the domain name suggests a Grand Forks affiliation, placing it as a potential overnight stop for touring cyclists on this scenic mountain highway.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://www.riversidemotelgf.com/ has been hijacked or domain-squatted by a Vietnamese online gambling site; it contains zero content related to the Riverside Motel. All amenity verification via the website is therefore impossible, and I must rely solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms a motel at 7351 Crowsnest Highway with a Wi-Fi tag (internet_access=wlan), but per the rules this OSM amenity tag cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration.
concerns: Website domain https://www.riversidemotelgf.com/ has been hijacked or domain-squatted by a Vietnamese online gambling/casino site; content is entirely unrelated to the motel.
No amenity information can be confirmed from the website; all WWC criteria are unverifiable.
Business operator should be contacted directly (phone or email from OSM) to verify current operation and update the website reference.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The motel's OSM record appears legitimate and its location on the Crowsnest Highway makes it a plausible WWC candidate, but the registered website domain has been hijacked by a Vietnamese gambling site, making it impossible to verify any cycling amenities, current operation, or contact details.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM lists email as riversidemotel@telus.net and phone as +1-250-442-2259; direct outreach is recommended to confirm the business is still operating and to obtain a valid website URL.
